name: SparseLeap
aliases: Empty Space Skipping via Rasterized Ray Segment Lists
SparseLeap-an effective empty space skipping technique
definition: A method that optimizes both the number of samples to evaluate and the number of look-ups into the empty-space skipping data structure.
summary: SparseLeap is a hybrid rasterization and ray-casting technique that skips empty space by rasterizing occupancy geometry into per-pixel linked lists, avoiding octree traversal overhead.
